scope: Scrape owned native acceptance source extension only; no product, Save, server, database, native browser, or release execution

selection.normal_width_mechanism: CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride on the owned SIDE_PANEL target, before warm controls and again on the replacement SIDE_PANEL after full extension reload
selection.normal_width_limit: Emulated panel viewport only; this does not verify Chrome's native divider resize behavior
selection.normal_width_knob: scrape_normal_width_px is mandatory in normal mode; observed innerWidth must meet it

authentication.reload: Replacement panel must reproduce the selected role, profile ID and organization ID/name; guest storage remains empty
authentication.receipt: Explicit selected auth mode, width mode, warm/reload observed viewport widths, sanitized authentication and reload checks, exact artifact provenance and existing lifecycle evidence

verification.focused_node_tests: 10 passed across hosted Scrape route, selection, and existing Settings auth driver
